question: In a series circuit, three resistors of 10 ohms, 20 ohms and R ohms are connected in series with a 12V battery. If the current flowing in the circuit is 0.2 A, what is the value of resistance R?
solution:
The correct answer is __30 ohms**(Option 3)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Series Circuit:__ In a series circuit, the total resistance is the sum of all resistances.
 
• Given resistances: 10 ohms, 20 ohms, and R ohms.
 
• Total voltage (V): 12V, Current (I): 0.2A.
 
• Using Ohm's Law: R = V/I.
 
• Total resistance: R = 12/0.2 = 60 ohms.
 
• Resistance R = Total resistance - Sum of other resistances.
 
• R = 60 - (10 + 20) = 30 ohms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Ohm's Law:**

 
 
• Ohm's Law states that the current through a conductor between two points is directly proportional to the voltage across the two points.
 
• Formula: V = I x R.
 
 
 
• **Series Circuit Characteristics:**
 
 
• The current is the same through all components.
 
• The total resistance is the sum of individual resistances.
